11793b670ef1e53af07cf3bdabfe85778118c1de.summary: This is a GitHub project README for PS>Attack, a portable PowerShell console that bundles many offensive post-exploitation modules and describes how to build and run it. It is a tool description, not an account of threat activity, so no threat facts are recorded.

11bb697ec74ff8bedc5d4284110aef0a6169afd8.summary: The GReAT team reports the EastWind campaign: from late July 2024 it targeted dozens of computers at Russian government organizations and IT companies, using phishing emails with malicious shortcut attachments. The attacks delivered GrewApacha, a RAT the report links to APT31, and an updated CloudSorcerer backdoor that uses Dropbox and social network profiles to find its command servers. A new implant, PlugY, shares code with the DRBControl backdoor, which the report says several companies link to APT27. The report says the campaign shows traces of two Chinese-speaking groups.
